title: 2025. Maximum Number of Ways to Partition an Array

examples.explanation: One optimal approach is to change nums[0] to k. The array becomes [3,-1,2]. There is one way to partition the array: - For pivot = 2, we have the partition [3,-1 | 2]: 3 + -1 == 2.

The optimal approach is to leave the array unchanged. There are two ways to partition the array: - For pivot = 1, we have the partition [0 | 0,0]: 0 == 0 + 0. - For pivot = 2, we have the partition [0,0 | 0]: 0 + 0 == 0.
One optimal approach is to change nums[2] to k. The array becomes [22,4,-33,-20,-15,15,-16,7,19,-10,0,-13,-14]. There are four ways to partition the array.
